workspaceActions.archivePublicText: The workspace becomes read-only, all members are removed, and you stop being the owner. Anyone can then take it.

workspaceActions.leaveText: You lose all your roles here. The owner can add you again.
workspaceActions.deleteText: Only a workspace without tasks can be deleted. Its files are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
